_: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Escha-W2: EschaLabs/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Escha-W2 (Apache-2.0), a Qwen3.6-MoE fine-tune, architecture qwen35moe, in peasantsmith's GGUF - 35B parameters, 256 experts with 8 routed a token, 40 trunk layers (30 GatedDeltaNet, 10 GQA) plus its MTP block. The `mntq` engine runs it from the file in place (tools/iq_pack.py indexes it; the pack is native, so --serve is served from the verify-window loop - qwen35moe has no batched prefill: --prefill 0). "revision" is the commit the files were uploaded at and the file has its sha256: the setup checks it against it. Only the smallest quant the repo publishes is pinned here (IQ2_XXS, ~10.4 GB: the whole model in a few GB of RAM); the repo also carries IQ3_XXS, Q3_K_M and Q4_K_M. No vision: the model reads text only, and its MTP drafter is built from its NextN block like every model that carries one (tools/mtp_from_gguf.py writes the block's own Q4_K/Q6_K expert bytes, and src/core/mtp.cpp's record_forward_plain is its draft graph); the setup keeps the drafts when the measuring says they are faster.
